content:
We are officially back! You can find us at the Crozet Farmers Market each Saturday (weather permitting), selling farm-fresh chicken eggs and beef. Back at the farm, we have recently welcomed some new arrivals. We now have eight new calves and a couple of ducks. These new arrivals have left us with full hearts and full hands! If you or anyone you know may be interested in volunteering, please reach out to us! 

Our pavilion is taking shape! We are in the framing stage and hope to have it fully functional by Summer 2025. Thanks to all of the hard work from individuals we serve, staff, and many volunteers, our high tunnel is up and running. We have planted the very first batch of seedlings and look forward to the sprouting of tomatoes, eggplant, peppers, and so much more!
